$comment: Recommended GitHub About metadata for the structured-cards repository. Kept in-repo so it cannot drift, and so it can be applied without any CLI at hand (Settings -> General in the UI, or the REST API notes in docs/release-process.md). The plugin reads structured-field and structured-card codeblocks only; it never touches note properties (YAML frontmatter), so the description says exactly that.
name: Structured Cards
description: 🃏 Render structured-card and structured-field Markdown codeblocks as interactive, customizable visual cards inside Obsidian.
